newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close up on short covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close up on short covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed slightly up on short-covering on Monday's clearing day, dealers said. Share prices were likely to open slightly higher on new buying expected on Tuesday's new accounts day.
The Karachi 100-share index closed 2.20 points, or 0.16 percent, up at 1,419.87 amid 209 losers and 88 gainers. Volume rose to 12 million shares from Sunday's 10 million.
The index edged up due to limited buying by local and foreign financial institutions, dealer Faisal Abbas said.
Limited offers in illiquid stocks showed that investors were not interested in selling at these levels, one broker said.
Pakistan State Oil added 4.00 rupees to 336, Shell Pakistan gained 2.00 to 129 and HUBCO climbed 0.40 to 30.20. Lever Brothers dipped 5.00 to 665 and Engro 1.00 to 144.
